description: Plubox helps authenticated property managers review organizations, bookings and booking payments, schedules, nightly and long-term prices, stored Booking.com market availability and Airbnb competitors, expenses, utility payments, tasks, cleanings, and statistics; it provides occupancy and pricing recommendations and makes only bounded operational and financial changes with explicit confirmation.

defaultPrompt: Show today’s arrivals, departures, cleanings, and outstanding payments.
Find equipment shortages across my accommodations and group them by property.
Summarize this month’s booking and expense statistics and highlight notable changes.
